value.rationale: Classical real Betti numbers for this natural nilpotent almost-abelian family are known; the characteristic-two exceptional fiber is genuinely different beginning at the first rank r=3. The theorem identifies the entire all-dimensional modular cohomological profile and exact integral 2-primary torsion multiplicities, revealing systematic failure of rational base change and providing invariants useful in modular deformations and finite-characteristic Lie cohomology. It excludes unsupported torsion exponents and odd primes.
